title: Opportunity Discovery
summary: A research and review tool for finding organizations, checking public evidence and preparing a specific offer before outreach.
oneLiner: A research and review tool for finding organizations, checking public evidence and preparing a specific offer before outreach.

assets.label: Reviewing a fictional organization in the live app interface
assets.summary: The review keeps the public activity, inferred need and next decision separate.

assets.label: Decision and proposed offer for a fictional exhibit
assets.summary: Reviewers can pursue, pass, research further or save a case. The proposed offer is marked as inferred.

caseStudy.problem: Public directories and awards explain what organizations do. A useful proposal still needs evidence of what someone might need.
caseStudy.role: I built the public-data collectors, review dashboard, iPhone client and approval workflow.
architecture: Collectors preserve source links and versioned source records. SQLite stores the review state and drafts.
The iPhone app and dashboard share the review workflow. Approved messages go through a durable, scheduled outbox.
decisions: Show potential fit and evidence confidence separately. Require approval of the exact message and recipient before scheduling outreach.
validation: The private iPhone client has been tested against the deployed Raspberry Pi service. The portfolio capture uses a fictional organization in an isolated database.
